title: Discovery -> Main Merge Log Entry
description: Schema for a single line of analysis/canonical/merge_logs/discovery_to_main_merge_log.jsonl. Each line is one merge event emitted by bsa-orchestrator during the discovery->Stage-1 bridge. See skills/bsa-orchestrator/references/discovery_to_main_merge.md for the full contract.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this event within the run. Pattern: MRG-<6+ digits>.

canon_policy_version.description: CanonPolicyVersion active at merge time. Accepts bare '<M.N>' / '<M.N.P>' or Sprint-3 '<M.N.P>+hash:<sha256>' form.

resolution.description: informational: no analyst action. soft_resolved: orchestrator resolved automatically (e.g., tier-mismatch higher-wins). hard_blocked: promotion halted; A51 contradiction raised.

discovery_id.description: Discovery-side identifier involved in the event (D-C-xxx / S-xxx / E-xxx). Required for all events except source_new.

main_id.description: Main-side identifier involved in the event (C-xxx / S-xxx / E-xxx). Required for events that produce a main-side row (source_reused, source_new, excerpt_reused, claim_lineage, a60_lineage).

a51_ref.description: A51Ref raised when resolution=hard_blocked. Required iff resolution=hard_blocked.

conflict_detail.description: Free-form detail for conflict events. Required iff event ends in '_conflict' or '_mismatch'.

notes.description: Optional free-text annotation for human readers.
